title: Pipeline as Code
description: Every check, build and deployment step lives in versioned workflow files that are reviewed like any other code.

title: Quality Gates
description: Linting, strict type checking, unit tests with coverage thresholds and accessibility audits block risky changes before merge.

title: Immutable Container Images
description: One image is built per unique source tree and promoted unchanged from test to stage to production.

title: Supply Chain Security
description: Secret scanning, dependency review, CodeQL and Trivy image scans run on every pull request.

title: Release Governance
description: Protected branches, required reviews and environment approvals keep production releases deliberate and auditable.

title: Fast Rollbacks
description: Any previously deployed commit can be redeployed from its existing image in minutes, without a rebuild.
